summary: 10.0.36.06 Full Contract Parity: Zero-Null Primitives & Explicit Field Population for Sales & Purchases Loader, OperationsService Contract Sanitizer, and Desktop Record Deserialization Guard
highlights: 1. Sales & Purchase Loader Contract Parity: Explicitly provided all 45 contract fields on salePayload and purchasePayload in ImportService.js, including emailSent: false, whatsappSent: false, chargeType, chargeAmount, and metadata defaults.

2. OperationsService Defense-in-Depth Sanitizer: Added _sanitizeSalePayload and _sanitizePurchasePayload in OperationsService to ensure all boolean and numeric contract fields are safely defaulted before HTTP transmission.
3. PurchaseController Contract Fix: Added emailSent: false to new purchase creations in PurchaseController.js.

4. Server Record Deserialization Hardening: Updated SaleDto and PurchaseDto in OperationDtos.java to use Boolean with compact constructor defaults, eliminating Jackson InvalidNullException when primitives are omitted.
5. Version & Cache-Buster Synchronization: Updated index.html, version.json, and js/version.js to 10.0.36.06.
